records.title: 1031 Exchange Basics
records.summary: Fundamental training on 1031 exchanges for real estate agents. Covers what a 1031 exchange is, when it applies, the critical rules and timelines (45-day identification, 180-day close), qualified intermediary requirements, like-kind property definition, boot rules, and common mistakes that disqualify the exchange. Includes Utah-specific disclosure forms and practical guidance for working with investor clients.

records.title: CMAs with Craig - April 1, 2026
records.summary: Hands-on CMA training session where Craig walks agents through real-world property pricing scenarios. Covers duplex valuation using sales comparables vs gross rent multiplier, COVID-era purchase pricing traps, builder MLS manipulation tactics, floor plan and location defects that affect value, commission negotiation scripts, and how to handle unrealistic seller expectations.

records.title: CMAs with Craig - August 5, 2026
records.summary: Hands-on CMA training session where Craig walks through two live property analyses: a two-story home in Murray (5646 South Crown Point Drive) and a rambler in Eagle Mountain (3827 East Pawnee Road). Covers the complete CMA workflow from tax record lookup through comp selection, adjustment methodology, and pricing recommendations. Key topics include how to handle properties with limited comps, when to stretch geographic boundaries, how to screen comps by lot size/year built/square footage, making upgrade adjustments, and communicating conservative ranges to sellers when interior condition is unknown.

records.title: CMA - Flip Property and Land
records.summary: Craig walks through CMA methodology for flip properties and land valuations. Covers lot subdivision analysis, land comp selection, ARV (After Repair Value) calculations, flip profit math, flag lot requirements, and how to evaluate properties with development potential. Includes specific examples from Springville, UT and demonstrates how to use MLS data for land valuations.

records.title: CMAs with Craig - July 8, 2026
records.summary: Craig walks through a condo CMA in Cottonwood Heights (The Orchard/Country Woods) using the MLS CMA tool. He demonstrates how to verify listing details against tax records, set search parameters for condos within the immediate subdivision, adjust comparables by square footage, garage, year built, and condition/upgrades. He explains market timing effects, how to identify outliers, the importance of professional photography, and how to price based on three tiers of condition (outdated, partially updated, fully updated).

records.title: CMAs with Craig - June 17, 2026
records.summary: Craig walks through two live CMA analyses: a 1950s off-market bungalow in Rose Park (Salt Lake City) needing TLC, and a 1925 outdated home on 4.74 acres in Highland with subdivision potential. Covers comp selection, condition adjustments, acreage valuation, investor flip math, seller financing exclusions, and highest-and-best-use analysis for land subdivision.

records.title: CMA Tips and a Flip with Craig - July 22, 2026
records.summary: Live CMA training session where Craig walks through a flip property analysis in St. George, Utah. Covers CMA creation workflow, comp selection strategy, adjustment factors for ADUs and roofs, qualitative vs quantitative analysis, and detailed walkthrough of every adjustment category (bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage, basement, year built, garage, lot size). Also includes best practices for comp bracketing, handling data errors, and determining after-repair value for investment properties.

records.title: Townhome CMA with Craig - May 13, 2026
records.summary: Craig walks agent Jake through a live CMA for a townhome listing in Lehi, Utah (Innocenti Days / Leather Ridge community). Covers townhome-specific comp selection tricks, adjusting for garage size (one vs two car), end unit vs mid unit premiums, finished vs unfinished basement impact, rear-loaded vs front-loaded layout preferences, private yard value, and the critical 'gut check' step of analyzing active competition before setting list price. Recommends pricing at $450K with marketing strategies for a buyer's market.

records.title: CMA's - Triplex, Addition, Nightly Rental
records.summary: Craig analyzes complex property scenarios including a triplex/fourplex in Hurricane, UT, a home with unpermitted addition in West Jordan, and nightly rental considerations. Covers cross-collateralization issues with lenders, ADU regulations, unpermitted square footage valuation, short-term rental income analysis, and how to properly comp properties with unique characteristics.

records.title: Making Connections Using Storytelling
records.summary: Training session on Donald Miller's 'Building a StoryBrand' framework applied to real estate client acquisition. Covers the hero's journey narrative structure, positioning the client as hero and agent as mystical guide, the seven-step brand script framework, and practical applications for buyer/seller consultations, email campaigns, social media, and client communication.

records.title: Nerdy Nuances and Negotiation Nuggets
records.summary: Training session covering 10-12 contract maneuvers and 4-5 negotiation tactics for real estate agents. Topics include earnest money leverage, delayed possession vs leaseback, assessment sections, hidden second due diligence deadline, new construction completion notices, deadline reminder strategy, response deadline clarification, contingent cancellation addendum, escalation clauses, backup offers, and the power of goodwill in negotiations.

records.title: Planned Decision Making
records.summary: Training on decision-making frameworks adapted from fighter pilot methodology. Marty introduces the OODA loop (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act) and the FACADE model (Focus, Assess, Consider, Act, Decide, Evaluate) as tools for making better decisions under stress in real estate transactions. Uses examples from Hazard Lee's 'The Art of Clear Thinking' and applies military decision-making concepts to client situations.

records.title: Repair Negotiations Training
records.summary: Comprehensive training on repair negotiations from both buyer and listing agent perspectives. Covers the three buckets of negotiation items (safety/health, big ticket, cosmetic), scripting for aggressive but ethical negotiations, upfront disclosure strategies for listing agents, and handling common objections. Includes specific tactics for electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, meth, radon, and structural issues.

records.title: Common REPC Errors to Avoid
records.summary: Training on common errors agents make with the Real Estate Purchase Contract (REPC) in Utah. Covers earnest money issues, wire transfers vs cashier's checks, included items disputes, math errors, settlement vs closing confusion, HOA fees, compensation structure pitfalls, seller disclosures, PID disclosure requirements, appraisal issues, and buyer cancellation rights.

records.title: Short Sales - How to Buy & Sell
records.summary: Comprehensive training on short sales covering what they are, why sellers and buyers participate, the approval process, key departments (loan servicing vs loss mitigation), critical forms, and negotiation strategies. Marty shares real-world examples from the 2008 crash era and current market conditions.
